description: Pinned SimForge container image identifiers. Updated when a new thesis-tier benchmark run wants to commit to a specific immutable image digest. The GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/build-container.yml publishes images to GHCR on every push; the digests here are the ones that thesis numbers were measured against.

thesis_default.branch_status: Built from commit db8d786 on branch phase-14-canonical-routes, which was later consolidated into the default 'release' branch (and history rewritten). That commit is no longer reachable from release and the branch tag no longer exists on GitHub; the GHCR image under this tag remains the immutable artifact the thesis benchmark numbers were measured against. Pull by digest if the tag is unavailable.
thesis_default.verified_by: apptainer 1.4.5; sumo --version → Eclipse SUMO sumo 1.26.0; java -version → openjdk 17.0.19; chicago_1k_car run inside container completed (20/20 cells)
thesis_default.notes: First successful GHA build landed 2026-05-19 after 8 iterations of debugging eclipse-sumo manylinux dependency closure on Debian Bookworm slim (libX11, libGL, libatomic, ...) + MATSim 15.0 release URL discovery. See CHANGELOG.md Wave 2 + doc/CONTAINER_USAGE.md for full details. Used by SBATCHs when SIMFORGE_USE_CONTAINER=1 is set without a specific SIMFORGE_CONTAINER_TAG override.
